title: Supplementaries Crowbar
description: Make the wrench from Supplementaries look like a crowbar from Half-Life!
body:
Bash the skulls of those who wronged you with this hunk of metal and feel smart at the same time. Does not come with a HEV suit. 

Renames the item and the achievement related to it. Currently supports only two languages: Russian and English

Also checkout: 

https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create-crowbar-wrench
